title: knowledge_acquisition.stage.completed payload (v1)
description: Payload of the knowledge_acquisition.stage.completed outbox event. Producer: app/knowledge_acquisition/stage_events.py::emit_stage_completed (stage, stage_version, content_identity, optional extractor_id/model_identity/artifact_path). Consumer (KA-07, #3107): app/workers/outbox_worker.py::handle_knowledge_acquisition_stage_completed -- a bounded downstream action (candidate-stage completions emit a ready-for-triage observability signal; other stages are a traced no-op).
